product_name: Artbook - Sách Tiếng Anh - Lili Reynaud-Dewar
product_description:
Lili Reynaud-Dewar: This is a book about the French artist Lili Reynaud-Dewar, who uses her own body to examine the dual experience of vulnerability and empowerment that results from exposing oneself to the world. Her work spans performance, video, installation, sound, and literature, and questions the fluid border between public and private space. The book includes a survey by Élisabeth Lebovici, an interview by Monika Szewczyk, and a focus by Diedrich Diederichsen
